The 1957 Soviet Cup, also known as the 1957 USSR Football Cup, was the third season of the Soviet Cup, a knockout football cup competition in the Soviet Union. The tournament was held from June to October 1957 and featured 48 teams from across the country.

The final match of the 1957 Soviet Cup was held on October 13, 1957, at the Lenin Stadium in Moscow. The final was contested between FC Torpedo Moscow and FC Dynamo Moscow. Torpedo Moscow emerged victorious with a 2-0 win, claiming their first Soviet Cup title.

The goals in the final were scored by Valentin Bubukin and Yevgeni Streltsov for Torpedo Moscow. The victory was seen as an upset, as Dynamo Moscow was the defending champions and a dominant force in Soviet football at the time.

Overall, the 1957 Soviet Cup was a significant tournament in Soviet football history, showcasing the talent and competitiveness of teams across the country. Torpedo Moscow's victory marked a memorable moment for the club and its fans.
